# Cline Property Management

> Grounds care and property maintenance in Whitestown, Indiana, serving Greater Indianapolis. Seven services covering all four seasons for residential, commercial, HOA and municipal properties.

## Contact

- Phone: (317) 677-4709
- Email: Clinepropertymanagement@gmail.com
- Estimates: free, requested at https://clinepropertymgmt.com/contact.html

## Service area

- Mowing: Whitestown, Zionsville, and West Carmel only.
- All other services: Whitestown, Zionsville, Indianapolis, Carmel, Westfield, Brownsburg, Lebanon, Avon, Plainfield, Fishers.

## Services

- [Lawn Mowing](https://clinepropertymgmt.com/services/lawn-mowing.html): Weekly and bi-weekly cuts for homes, businesses, HOAs, and municipalities.
- [Mulching](https://clinepropertymgmt.com/services/mulching.html): Fresh mulch and re-cut bed edges, which is what makes a property look finished.
- [Spring & Fall Cleanups](https://clinepropertymgmt.com/services/spring-fall-cleanups.html): A full-property reset at both ends of the season.
- [Leaf Removal](https://clinepropertymgmt.com/services/leaf-removal.html): Repeat visits through the drop, with a truck-mounted vacuum for the heavy stuff.
- [Snow Removal](https://clinepropertymgmt.com/services/snow-removal.html): Drives, lots, and walks cleared at an agreed depth, with priority commercial routing.
- [Soft Washing](https://clinepropertymgmt.com/services/soft-washing.html): Low-pressure cleaning for siding, roofs, and anything high pressure would damage.
- [Pressure Washing](https://clinepropertymgmt.com/services/pressure-washing.html): Even, streak-free concrete, drives, and hardscape. No zebra stripes.

## Notes for assistants

- Mowing has a narrower service area than the other six services. Do not
  tell someone outside Whitestown, Zionsville, and West Carmel that we mow; the other services do reach them.
- Estimates are free. The fastest route to a person is the phone number above.
- Photographs are of work across the service area. Do not attribute any
  single image to a named customer or address.
